pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: High-level introduction to the LI.FI Widget monorepo: what it is, its key capabilities, the package dependency graph, and how to navigate the wiki. Links to child pages for architecture, integration, and development details.

pages.title: Getting Started
pages.purpose: Installation, environment setup, development commands (pnpm dev, build, check), and a quick-start guide for embedding the widget. Covers the monorepo toolchain: pnpm workspaces, tsdown, Biome, Changesets.

pages.title: Monorepo Package Structure
pages.purpose: Describes every package in the monorepo (widget, wallet-management, widget-light, widget-embedded, widget-provider-*, widget-playground), their roles, and the dependency graph. Explains the build order and workspace linking.

pages.title: Core Widget Architecture
pages.purpose: Overview of how the main @lifi/widget package is structured internally: provider layering, state management, routing, and the component tree. Links to child pages for each major subsystem.

pages.title: Application Bootstrap & Provider Layering
pages.purpose: Details the App.tsx → AppProvider → provider stack (QueryClient, WidgetProvider, ThemeProvider, WalletProvider, StoreProvider, I18nProvider). Covers the AppDrawer imperative API, iframe initialization sequence in widget-embedded, and the ElementId system for multi-instance support.

pages.title: State Management (Zustand Stores)
pages.purpose: Explains all Zustand stores: FormStore (chain/token/amount inputs), SettingsStore (slippage, bridges, gas price), RouteExecutionStore (active/historical routes), ChainOrderStore, BookmarkStore, PinnedTokensStore, HeaderStore. Covers StoreProvider composition and localStorage namespacing.

pages.title: Navigation & Page Routing
pages.purpose: Covers TanStack Router integration, the navigationRoutes manifest, page components (MainPage, RoutesPage, TransactionPage, SelectTokenPage, SelectChainPage, SettingsPage, ActivitiesPage, SendToWalletPage), and how the widget manages internal SPA navigation without URL changes.

pages.title: Theming System
pages.purpose: Explains the MUI v7-based theming: createTheme(), WidgetTheme config, CSS variables (--lifi-* prefix), color schemes (light/dark/system), built-in themes (azureLight, watermelonLight, jumper, windows95), border radius tokens, and how integrators customize appearance.

pages.title: Widget Configuration API
pages.purpose: Overview of the WidgetConfig interface and how integrators control widget behavior. Links to child pages covering the full config schema, layout variants, operational modes, and the event system.

pages.title: WidgetConfig Reference
pages.purpose: Full reference for the WidgetConfig type: required fields (integrator), chain/token presets, disabledUI/hiddenUI/requiredUI/defaultUI toggles, SDK config overrides (apiUrl, rpcUrls, routeOptions), feeConfig, walletConfig, contractCalls, and the FormRef imperative API.

pages.title: Layout Variants & Widget Modes
pages.purpose: Explains the three layout variants (compact, wide, drawer) and operational modes (default, split, refuel, custom/checkout/deposit). Covers the useWideVariant hook, DrawerAPI, chainSidebar, and how mode affects UI labels and navigation.

pages.title: Widget Events
pages.purpose: Documents the WidgetEvent enum and useWidgetEvents hook: RouteSelected, AvailableRoutes, RouteExecutionStarted/Updated/Completed/Failed, SettingUpdated, PageEntered, ChainPinned, TokenSearch, WalletConnected/Disconnected. Explains the eventemitter3-based pub/sub pattern.

pages.title: Route Discovery & Transaction Execution
pages.purpose: Overview of the full swap/bridge lifecycle from route fetching through execution. Links to child pages for route discovery, execution engine, and the transaction UI.

pages.title: Route Discovery (useRoutes)
pages.purpose: Deep dive into useRoutes: query key construction, validation (toAddress ecosystem check), concurrent quoting (getRoutes + getRelayerQuote + getContractCallsQuote), route merging, cache synchronization, ProgressToNextUpdate (60s stale time), and the RoutesPage/RoutesExpanded UI.

pages.title: Route Execution Engine (useRouteExecution)
pages.purpose: Covers the useRouteExecution hook: executeRoute, resumeRoute, restartRoute, deleteRoute, background execution on unmount, automatic resumption on mount, cache invalidation (token-balances, transaction-history), and RouteExecutionStatus state machine.

pages.title: Transaction UI (TransactionPage & Step Components)
pages.purpose: Explains TransactionPage pre-flight checks (address activity, value loss threshold), StartTransactionButton, Step/StepList rendering, StepActions (bridge/swap/protocol labels), StatusBottomSheet terminal states (Done/Partial/Refunded/Failed), and TransactionDetailsPage history reconstruction.

pages.title: Fee & Cost Calculation
pages.purpose: Documents getAccumulatedFeeCostsBreakdown, integrator fee detection via feeCollectionStep, gas cost aggregation, price impact calculation (getPriceImpact), FeeBreakdownTooltip, TransactionDetails component, and the TokenValueBottomSheet high-value-loss safety gate.

pages.title: Token & Chain Selection
pages.purpose: Overview of the asset selection subsystem: token lists, chain lists, search, balances, and gas sufficiency. Links to child pages for each major component.

pages.title: Token List & Search
pages.purpose: Covers TokenList, VirtualizedTokenList (react-virtual), TokenListItem, TokenDetailsSheetContent, useTokens (verified/unverified), useTokenSearch (address lookup + cache injection), useTokenBalances, token categories (pinned/featured/popular), allow/deny filtering, and the small-balance threshold.

pages.title: Chain Selection & Ordering
pages.purpose: Explains ChainSelect, VirtualizedChainList, ChainOrderStore (user-reorderable chain list), ChainsExpanded sidebar (wide variant), useAvailableChains, useChains filtering by FormType and ChainType, and the SelectChainPage.

pages.title: Gas Sufficiency & Refuel
pages.purpose: Documents useGasSufficiency (per-step gas validation pipeline, refuel detection via gasZip), useGasRefuel (50% threshold check), useGasRecommendation, GasRefuelMessage UI, and how the system handles insufficient gas warnings across multi-step cross-chain routes.

pages.title: Wallet Management
pages.purpose: Overview of the multi-ecosystem wallet layer: @lifi/wallet-management, @lifi/widget-provider, and chain-specific providers. Links to child pages for each ecosystem.

pages.title: @lifi/wallet-management
pages.purpose: Covers WalletManagementProvider, WalletManagementProviders, WalletMenuProvider, useCombinedWallets, useAccount, useAccountDisconnect, WalletMenuContent UI, wallet priority sorting, connector icons, and the WalletManagementEvent system.

pages.title: Chain-Specific Providers
pages.purpose: Documents @lifi/widget-provider (base contexts: EthereumContext, SolanaContext, BitcoinContext, SuiContext, TronContext), and each chain provider package: widget-provider-ethereum (wagmi/viem), widget-provider-solana (wallet-standard/zustand), widget-provider-bitcoin (bigmi), widget-provider-sui (dapp-kit-react), widget-provider-tron.

pages.title: Header & Wallet UI
pages.purpose: Explains the Header component system: NavigationHeader (back button, split tabs, settings/activities buttons), WalletHeader (multi-account display, active account by fromChain), WalletMenu (copy address, explorer links, disconnect), height observation via ResizeObserver, and sticky header logic.

pages.title: Iframe Integration (widget-light & widget-embedded)
pages.purpose: Overview of the iframe-based integration pattern. Links to child pages for the host-side API and the guest-side embedded widget.

pages.title: Host Side: @lifi/widget-light
pages.purpose: Documents LiFiWidgetLight component, useWidgetLightHost hook, postMessage protocol (READY→INIT→CONFIG_UPDATE, RPC_REQUEST/RESPONSE, EVENT, WIDGET_EVENT), WidgetLightEventBus, useWidgetLightEvents, ecosystem handlers (ethereum/solana/bitcoin/sui/tron subpath imports), and WidgetLightConfig (serializable subset of WidgetConfig).

pages.title: Guest Side: @lifi/widget-embedded
pages.purpose: Covers the widget-embedded Vite app: GuestBridge singleton, IFRAME_PROVIDERS, EthereumIframeProvider, WalletProvider for iframe, initialization sequence (READY signal, INIT response, ecosystem states), and the WidgetEventsBridge for event forwarding.

pages.title: Settings & User Preferences
pages.purpose: Covers the SettingsPage and all user-configurable options: slippage, route priority, gas price tiers, bridge/exchange toggles, small balance filter, theme selection, language selection, and the ResetSettingsButton. Explains how settings persist via Zustand + localStorage.

pages.title: Internationalization (i18n)
pages.purpose: Explains the i18next-based localization system: JSON key schema (button, header, info, warning, error, success, main, settings, format), supported languages (20+), Crowdin integration, dynamic loading, custom formatters (currencyExt, numberExt), and how to add new translations.
